Workplan now applies one complete policy by default. Incomplete capability text,
unowned public code or tests, unsupported claims, missing runnable examples and
unexplained source lines are ordinary findings. The debt record ratchets down
and refuses growth or stale identities.

RAF adopts that policy across all eight first-party packages with zero debt,
real claim-level bindings and examples, and 113 current accepted assessments.
Typed command results use the shared native RDF graph for Turtle and N-Triples
alongside human-readable output. Compatible scalar, text, digest, allocation
and fixture operations use the pinned PurRDF libraries.

Bound verification records compiler-proved platform exclusion separately from
a passing test, retains the exclusion receipt, and refuses to publish it as
passing execution evidence. Rustdoc retains its own listing and execution proof.
Shared fixture implementations have one selectable assertion owner.

Validation: actual strict and adoption lifecycles passed; the resulting live
tree matched its final candidate. Required local gate steps passed, including
workspace and release tests, documentation, licensing, MSRV, all five fuzz
targets and all three platform cross-checks. Normal commit hooks passed.
All twelve hosted checks passed, including native Linux, macOS and Windows
runtime jobs. The portable fixtures retain the real production failure paths.

Closes #16.
Closes #37.

The remaining machine-output, preferred-provider, resolver and three-host runtime
contracts remain tracked by #40, #53, #28 and #23.
title: feat(workplan): enforce complete policy and adopt without debt

comments.body:
Integrated the delivered census/source-root foundation and the maintainer's local policy commits through ordinary merges, preserving the existing strict implementation and unfinished adoption work.

Fixed a reproduced reachability bug in `07169f5`: packages of different editions sharing one physical source file reused the first edition's keyword-filtered runs. The cache now uses file and edition. Tests cover combined versus separate roots, reversed root order, swapped editions, raw-identifier neighbors, the real workplan line-coverage caller, and exact/one-byte-short retained-memory limits.

Focused verification passed: 24 reachability integration tests, 15 reachability unit tests, 19 line-coverage tests, 5 touched-surface tests, denied-warning clippy and workspace all-target compilation. The normal commit hook passed formatting, REUSE, 31 document-contract tests, 68 repository gates and the self-workplan gate. No bypass was used.

This is an intermediate repair, not completion of the revised contract. Shared RDF results, removal of the alternative coverage policy, actual zero-debt repository adoption and final full qualification remain in the same delivery. Parent RDF scope stays open for census debt and CLI consumers.
